## We turn children into successful adults®

## Proudly Serving San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton,Capitol Expressway, Mountain View and surrounding communities.

* * *

## Find the Kung Fu Kids® program for you:

## Grasshoppers  (Ages 2-3)

* * *

From listening skills to taking turns, our program for ages 2-3 teach way more than physical skills! Your child will learn how to interact in a social setting, plus learn valuable life lessons that will help them as they grow.

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Little Pandas  (Ages 4-6)

* * *

There's nothing more satisfying than watching your 4-6 year old gain physical and social skills that you know will benefit them for life. Your little one will learn focus, self-confidence and discipline, while getting a full body work out. Preschool Martial Arts teach fantastic martial arts moves plus vital interpersonal skills.

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Mighty Tigers  (Ages 7-9)

* * *

Mighty Tigers is a great way for kids to not only develop their physical skills through this exciting Martial Arts class, but it's also a great way to help them develop the mental and emotional skills they'll need to succeed in life!

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Rising Dragons  (Ages 10-14)

* * *

Martial Arts is one of the best possible activities for children. They'll learn to defend themselves physically, but more importantly they'll build the mental and emotional skill sets necessary to conquer challenges like high school, college, and becoming a healthy, balanced adult.

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Spectrum Stars

* * *

This program was designed to target children on the spectrum at Kung Fu Kids®. The program introduces specialized skill-based training for children who have limited physical, intellectual, social, and emotional abilities. With that said, more emphasis is placed on building fundamental skills training with a strategic balance of Martial Arts.

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Women's   Self-Defense

* * *

Self Defense training is essential for women in order to prevent attacks. We'll train your mind and develop your instincts to avoid danger. In addition, you'll learn how to use physical force to protect yourself in order to survive and escape.

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Women's   Self-Defense

* * *

Self Defense training is essential for women in order to prevent attacks. We'll train your mind and develop your instincts to avoid danger. In addition, you'll learn how to use physical force to protect yourself in order to survive and escape.

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Private Lessons

* * *

Need a little extra help on some skills, or feel like you're not quite ready for group classes? We can help with dedicated private instruction tailored to exactly what you need. We'll help you hone your skills, but more importantly, we'll give you the confidence you've been looking for in your training!

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Birthday Parties

* * *

From setup to clean up, we have you covered! Your child and their friends will play games, be entertained, and even learn real martial arts moves. Parents say it's one of the most unique and coolest parties they've ever been to!

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

## Parent's Night Out

* * *

Kids LOVE Parent's Night Out at Kung Fu Kids® just almost as much as parents do! It's the super fun alternative to finding a babysitter - no more stressing about how to get a night for yourself!

* * *

[LEARN MORE](https://kungfu.kids/#)

The best in San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway and Mountain View

## Why San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway and Mountain View chooses Kung Fu Kids®

* * *

#### Schedule Focused

Our programs were created for real family schedules. Convenient class times mean that kids, adults, and whole families can improve their quality of life without killing every moment of spare time.

#### Community Positive

Our positive atmosphere is contagious, and you'll know without a doubt that you're in a place where kids will learn positive habits and adults will make meaningful, lasting friendships.

#### Values Oriented

All of our programs improve physical prowess, and that's important. But what's far more important is the mental and emotional benefits that the martial arts, kung fu and karate teachings our programs bring to everyday life.

#### Movement Based

Both kids and adults will gain flexibility, agility, and strength, even if they aren't athletic! They'll love it, because it's not only super fun, it’s inclusive and accommodating at every step.

San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway and Mountain View Kids agree:

## Kids choose Kung Fu Kids® every time

* * *

#### Amazing Classes

Kids love classes at Kung Fu Kids® because they're unbelievably fun (but parents love them because they build benefits for life!)

#### Structured Activity

Everything we do is intentionally structured based on our extensive experience. Kids at Kung Fu Kids® actually like the structure, because it makes them feel safe and cared for. They can trust deep down that they're safe to explore and challenge themselves.

#### Full Inclusion

We take kids’ emotions seriously. The culture at Kung Fu Kids® is one of inclusion - no cliques, no cool kids club, no unkind actions or attitudes. Kids love it because they always feel like they belong!

#### Awesome Fun!

It's so much fun! At Kung Fu Kids®, we know that getting your child out of the house, in the car, and across town to an activity is a big deal. We guarantee that when they leave, it will have been 100% worth it, every time!

Programs built for real people

## Why Teens love Kung Fu Kids® Programs

* * *

#### Curriculum

Our classes were designed specifically for the average person. You'll build skills step by step, without having to be a superstar to see improvement. But stick with it, and you'll see your abilities soar!

#### Community

You'll will be surrounded by peers striving towards the same goals you are, day in, day out. You'll build friendships and be supported in your individual journey.

#### Mental Health

We've always known it, but now the science agrees: You must take time for your own mental health. Our classes help you clear your mind, accomplish your goals, and be more healthy, from the inside out.

#### Physical Skills

It's more than just learning awesome looking moves - it's proprioception, balance, agility and more - physical skills that will remain with and benefit you for the rest of your life.

## The best in San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway and Mountain View

## Welcome to Wushu Central's Kung Fu Kids®!

* * *

Wushu Central Martial Arts has received numerous awards including the "Nominated Best Traditional Martial Arts Academy in the United States" by Black Belt Magazine, Voted the "Family Favorite" by other local Martial Arts Academies in Bay Area Parent, and has been featured on NBC News, Discovery Channel, Bay Area Parents and many more!

![](https://kung-fu-kids.newmember5.ninja/wp-content/uploads/sites/6/2023/11/wushucentral001.png)

## What do actual Kung Fu Kids® members say?

* * *

We send regular anonymous surveys to our members in our program. Here's a sample of the real feedback we get regularly:

![](https://kung-fu-kids.newmember5.ninja/wp-content/uploads/sites/6/2023/11/david-chang-w9a5213-1024x683-1.jpg)

## Member Feedback

We've been going to Wushu for >3 years. We appreciate most how thoughtful, caring, and attentive the coaches and Sifu are. They demonstrate discipline and humility, which are difficult qualities for children to develop, especially these days with so many distractions. Thank you Wushu coaches for your dedication and leadership!

![](https://kung-fu-kids.newmember5.ninja/wp-content/uploads/sites/6/2023/11/david-chang-w9a5226-1024x683-1.jpg)

## Member Feedback

My son has been attending here for more than a year. The focus he has developed here has started to show in other areas of his life. He has fun and learns in every class. I am very glad my son has this outlet and he is excited about it every day. Wushu Central is a great place for kids and adults to learn a new discipline and meet great people.

## Ready to be part of Kung Fu Kids®? Select a Program and Get Started Today!

[Select Your Program](https://kungfu.kids/#programs)

![](https://kungfu.kids/wp-content/uploads/sites/6/2025/01/Kung-Fu-Kids-Logo-Simplified-1024x1024.png)

Kung Fu Kids® is the favorite choice of California families for their childrens' and teens' physical, mental and emotional development. Plus there’s no better facility for adults to improve their physical health and mental wellness. Martial Arts, Kung Fu, and Karate classes build benefits for life. Schedule your trial today!

We turn children into successful adults®

Proudly Serving San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway, Mountain View and surrounding communities.

Find the Kung Fu Kids® program for you:

Grasshoppers
(Ages 2-3)

From listening skills to taking turns, our program for ages 2-3 teach way more than physical skills! Your child will learn how to interact in a social setting, plus learn valuable life lessons that will help them as they grow.

LEARN MORE

Little Pandas
(Ages 4-6)

There's nothing more satisfying than watching your 4-6 year old gain physical and social skills that you know will benefit them for life. Your little one will learn focus, self-confidence and discipline, while getting a full body work out. Preschool Martial Arts teach fantastic martial arts moves plus vital interpersonal skills.

LEARN MORE

Mighty Tigers
(Ages 7-9)

Mighty Tigers is a great way for kids to not only develop their physical skills through this exciting Martial Arts class, but it's also a great way to help them develop the mental and emotional skills they'll need to succeed in life!

LEARN MORE

Rising Dragons
(Ages 10-14)

Martial Arts is one of the best possible activities for children. They'll learn to defend themselves physically, but more importantly they'll build the mental and emotional skill sets necessary to conquer challenges like high school, college, and becoming a healthy, balanced adult.

LEARN MORE

Spectrum Stars

This program was designed to target children on the spectrum at Kung Fu Kids®. The program introduces specialized skill-based training for children who have limited physical, intellectual, social, and emotional abilities. With that said, more emphasis is placed on building fundamental skills training with a strategic balance of Martial Arts.

LEARN MORE

Women's
Self-Defense

Self Defense training is essential for women in order to prevent attacks. We'll train your mind and develop your instincts to avoid danger. In addition, you'll learn how to use physical force to protect yourself in order to survive and escape.

LEARN MORE

Women's
Self-Defense

Self Defense training is essential for women in order to prevent attacks. We'll train your mind and develop your instincts to avoid danger. In addition, you'll learn how to use physical force to protect yourself in order to survive and escape.

LEARN MORE

Private Lessons

Need a little extra help on some skills, or feel like you're not quite ready for group classes? We can help with dedicated private instruction tailored to exactly what you need. We'll help you hone your skills, but more importantly, we'll give you the confidence you've been looking for in your training!

LEARN MORE

Birthday Parties

From setup to clean up, we have you covered! Your child and their friends will play games, be entertained, and even learn real martial arts moves. Parents say it's one of the most unique and coolest parties they've ever been to!

LEARN MORE

Parent's Night Out

Kids LOVE Parent's Night Out at Kung Fu Kids® just almost as much as parents do! It's the super fun alternative to finding a babysitter - no more stressing about how to get a night for yourself!

LEARN MORE

The best in San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway and Mountain View

Why San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway and Mountain View chooses Kung Fu Kids®

Schedule Focused 

Our programs were created for real family schedules. Convenient class times mean that kids, adults, and whole families can improve their quality of life without killing every moment of spare time.

Community Positive

Our positive atmosphere is contagious, and you'll know without a doubt that you're in a place where kids will learn positive habits and adults will make meaningful, lasting friendships.

Values Oriented

All of our programs improve physical prowess, and that's important. But what's far more important is the mental and emotional benefits that the martial arts, kung fu and karate teachings our programs bring to everyday life.

Movement Based

Both kids and adults will gain flexibility, agility, and strength, even if they aren't athletic! They'll love it, because it's not only super fun, it’s inclusive and accommodating at every step. 

San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway and Mountain View Kids agree:

Kids choose Kung Fu Kids® every time

Amazing Classes

Kids love classes at Kung Fu Kids® because they're unbelievably fun (but parents love them because they build benefits for life!)

Structured Activity

Everything we do is intentionally structured based on our extensive experience. Kids at Kung Fu Kids® actually like the structure, because it makes them feel safe and cared for. They can trust deep down that they're safe to explore and challenge themselves.

Full Inclusion

We take kids’ emotions seriously. The culture at Kung Fu Kids® is one of inclusion - no cliques, no cool kids club, no unkind actions or attitudes. Kids love it because they always feel like they belong!

Awesome Fun!

It's so much fun! At Kung Fu Kids®, we know that getting your child out of the house, in the car, and across town to an activity is a big deal. We guarantee that when they leave, it will have been 100% worth it, every time!

Programs built for real people

Why Teens love Kung Fu Kids® Programs

Curriculum

Our classes were designed specifically for the average person. You'll build skills step by step, without having to be a superstar to see improvement. But stick with it, and you'll see your abilities soar!

Community

You'll will be surrounded by peers striving towards the same goals you are, day in, day out. You'll build friendships and be supported in your individual journey.

Mental Health

We've always known it, but now the science agrees: You must take time for your own mental health. Our classes help you clear your mind, accomplish your goals, and be more healthy, from the inside out.

Physical Skills

It's more than just learning awesome looking moves - it's proprioception, balance, agility and more - physical skills that will remain with and benefit you for the rest of your life. 

The best in San Jose, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Capitol Expressway and Mountain View

Welcome to Wushu Central's Kung Fu Kids®!

Wushu Central Martial Arts has received numerous awards including the "Nominated Best Traditional Martial Arts Academy in the United States" by Black Belt Magazine, Voted the "Family Favorite" by other local Martial Arts Academies in Bay Area Parent, and has been featured on NBC News, Discovery Channel, Bay Area Parents and many more!

What do actual Kung Fu Kids® members say?

We send regular anonymous surveys to our members in our program. Here's a sample of the real feedback we get regularly:

Member Feedback

We've been going to Wushu for >3 years. We appreciate most how thoughtful, caring, and attentive the coaches and Sifu are. They demonstrate discipline and humility, which are difficult qualities for children to develop, especially these days with so many distractions. Thank you Wushu coaches for your dedication and leadership!

Member Feedback

My son has been attending here for more than a year. The focus he has developed here has started to show in other areas of his life. He has fun and learns in every class. I am very glad my son has this outlet and he is excited about it every day. Wushu Central is a great place for kids and adults to learn a new discipline and meet great people.

Ready to be part of Kung Fu Kids®? Select a Program and Get Started Today!

Select Your Program

Kung Fu Kids® is the favorite choice of California families for their childrens' and teens' physical, mental and emotional development. Plus there’s no better facility for adults to improve their physical health and mental wellness. Martial Arts, Kung Fu, and Karate classes build benefits for life. Schedule your trial today!

data.summary: Kung Fu Kids® offers various martial arts programs aimed at children's physical, mental, and emotional development across several locations in California, including San Jose, Palo Alto, and Pleasanton. The programs cater to different age groups: Grasshoppers (ages 2-3), Little Pandas (ages 4-6), Mighty Tigers (ages 7-9), and Rising Dragons (ages 10-14). Additionally, specialized programs for children on the spectrum and women's self-defense classes are available. The facilities promote positive community values, flexibility, agility, and structured activities to create a supportive environment for learning and growth, with classes designed for enjoyment and skill development.
